summaryDeep: Their affection, preferences, and wish to keep things pleasant work smoothly with your depth, control, and willingness to be exposed. It runs easily and asks little, quietly steadying the rest of the bond. Lean on how naturally this one lines up.
tension: The shadow is subtle. Because the connection feels natural, it can be easy to underestimate how much influence it carries. The Venus person may slowly begin organizing their sense of beauty, worth, or desire around the Pluto person's attention. The Pluto person may not realize how much power their approval or withdrawal has.
advice: Let the love deepen you, but keep your own sense of worth intact. This aspect can offer rare intimacy, but it still asks both people to stay aware of where devotion ends and dependency begins.
